# eSaludMental.es

> eSaludMental.es is a telemedicine platform providing psychological services and evidence-based mental health education grounded in positive psychology principles.

The site combines professional psychological services with educational resources on mental health, emotional wellbeing, and personal development. Content is informed by positive psychology frameworks and addresses both mental health conditions and psychological strengths.

## Key Topics

- Psicología Positiva
- Salud Mental
- Bienestar Emocional
- Fortalezas Mentales
- Debilidades Mentales
- Autoconocimiento
- Desarrollo Personal
- Telemedicina
- Trastornos Psicológicos
- Autorrealización
- Estigma Mental
- Servicios Psicológicos
- Martin Seligman
- Christopher Peterson
- Identificar Talentos

## About & Services

- [Acerca de](https://esaludmental.es/acerca-de): About eSaludMental.es: primary psychological services via telemedicine platform

## Mental Strengths & Personal Development

- [Fortalezas mentales de una persona](https://esaludmental.es/fortalezas): Identify and develop mental strengths using positive psychology principles
- [Debilidades mentales de una persona](https://esaludmental.es/debilidades): Guide to recognizing and overcoming mental weaknesses for psychological wellbeing

## Mental Health Conditions & Treatment

- [¿Qué es el tabaquismo? Causas, síntomas, efectos y tratamiento](https://esaludmental.es/tabaquismo): Comprehensive guide on tobacco addiction: causes, symptoms, effects and treatments
- [Qué es el cortisol y cómo afecta a tu cuerpo](https://esaludmental.es/cortisol): Guide to cortisol hormone: function, effects on health and stress response

## Educational & Scientific Resources

- [Triada ecológica: definición, elementos, funciones y ejemplos](https://esaludmental.es/triada-ecologica): Educational overview of ecological triad model in epidemiology and public health
- [¿Qué son los sistemas técnicos? Características, desarrollo, evaluación e importancia](https://esaludmental.es/sistemas-tecnicos): Explanation of socio-technical systems theory and organizational efficiency methodology
